snippet.title: Cyber Seraph 2nd Trailer, Showcasing A New Color Palette And Some Gameplay.
snippet.description:
Cyber Seraph is an indie shmup I'm working on, coming very soon to Steam and Itch. For more content, check out: 
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1310230/Cyber_Seraph/
Itch: https://cosmicvoid.itch.io/cyber-seraph
Twitter: https://twitter.com/void_breach
Patreon: https://patreon.com/voidbreach
Music by Dial-up for Murder.
